claims.statement: Offline replay of the retained 93-point AERO USD series (2026-07-18T00:00:00Z–2026-10-18T00:00:00Z) matched all 14 fields in the complete indicator contract. EMA uses the first close as seed; RSI(14) uses arithmetic-mean gains/losses, not Wilder smoothing; ATR is unavailable without OHLC. The original specialist MACD disagreement is NOT_REPRODUCIBLE because its reported value was not found in persisted handoffs.

Using matching daily USD point-price endpoints and (end/start - 1) * 100, AERO/BTC/ETH/SOL returns were respectively -11.82%/-1.91%/-4.12%/-5.88% over 7d (Oct 11–18), 33.25%/3.43%/-4.89%/-3.81% over 30d (Sep 18–Oct 18), and 89.18%/26.12%/28.31%/35.00% over 90d (Jul 20–Oct 18).
